name: otis
description: Repo-aware SpiderByte runtime, tool, ML, and data workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Repo-aware SpiderByte tools, runtime, ML, and data workflows.
interface.longDescription: Otis helps Codex work safely in SpiderByte's governed agent runtime and its ML/data platform, covering the built-in tool registry, governed platform tools, plugins and MCP boundaries, model catalogs, providers, datasets, artifacts, experiments, training, evaluation, transcript/search read models, SDK/server surfaces, and MiniDB persistence.
defaultPrompt: Review this change through SpiderByte's tool, runtime, ML, and data architecture.
Trace a SpiderByte tool, dataset, artifact, experiment, model, plugin, or API flow end to end.
Check policy, Run, persistence, search, transcript, MCP, and model-catalog invariants.
